subject: DPA: roles & transfer-impact triage + procurement handoff
body:
From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@luminahealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: sara.nguyen@luminahealth.com, procure@luminahealth.com
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA scope and SCCs – clarification before legal review

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. Legal at Lumina pulled the DPA and flagged two items we need clarified before we send our redlines back: 1) a clear statement of controller/processor roles for the order form (we have mixed language across exhibits) and 2) whether Redwood plans to rely on standard SCCs or a transfer-impact addendum for certain EU-hosted records.

Could you share your recommended approach and any examples of the transfer-impact addendum you use? Procurement would like to start the DocuSign flow next week, but legal needs the role language ironed out.

Appreciate it — Tom
Director, Procurement
Lumina Health


-----Original Message-----
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@luminahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA scope and SCCs – clarification before legal review

Tom —

Thanks for the note. High level recommended path:
- We keep the MSA/order form as-is for commercial terms; DPA will specify roles per-product (hosted API = processor; customer = controller).
- For EU transfers: we offer SCCs plus an optional Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) for customers that want an evidence-backed risk assessment and mitigations (KMS routing, VPC-only hosting, limited access lists).

I'm attaching a draft redline and our DPA template for your legal to review. The TIA is usually a short annex that references the SCCs and lists technical mitigations — we can pre-fill the Lumina-specific controls if you want.

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura and Monica — can you take Laura's redline template and prepare a version where controller/processor roles are explicit at the top of the DPA and add a short TIA stub?
2) Ben — once legal signs off, can you coordinate procurement timeline and the DocuSign envelope?
3) Tom — if Lumina wants the TIA pre-populated, please share which datasets (PHI flag?) and hosting region preferences.

I've attached: Lumina_DPA_Redline_v1.docx, Redwood_DPA_Template_2028-05.docx

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference


-----Original Message-----
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, Tom Blake <tom.blake@luminahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA scope and SCCs – clarification before legal review

Tom / team —

I reviewed Aditya's draft and made a handful of targeted edits. Key points from legal:
1) Roles: we will add an explicit Roles table in the DPA (section 1.1) that maps each product surface to controller/processor responsibilities. That will avoid ambiguity in the order form.
2) SCCs vs TIA: default path is to incorporate the EU SCCs (2021 module 2/3) and include language that Redwood may provide a TIA as an annex on request. The TIA should not be mandatory.
3) Evidence: Lumina asked for an evidence bundle (SOC 2 summary, encryption details, subprocessor list) — we can provide a staged evidence pack but need to define delivery timeline in the order form (e.g., evidence delivered within 5 business days after countersign).
4) Data flows: we will add a short data flow diagram placeholder and a subsection where Lumina can specify datasets that are considered sensitive/PHI. That drives the TIA scope.

Attached: Lumina_DPA_Redline_v1.docx (with track changes) and Lumina_SCCs_Impact_Summary.xlsx.

Open questions for Lumina:
- Please confirm whether Lumina requires KMS-managed keys or whether platform-side encryption with customer key escrow is acceptable.
- Confirm hosting region for EU records (single region vs multi-region).

If Lumina confirms, we can finalize redlines and Ben can start the procurement envelope.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference


-----Original Message-----
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@luminahealth.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA scope and SCCs – clarification before legal review

Tom —

Thanks for flagging timing. From procurement's side:
- If Lumina confirms the TIA is optional and does not require KMS HSM-backed keys for go-live, we can move forward on a 10-business-day procurement cadence (signature target: 2028-05-28).
- I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope once Laura confirms the final DPA file. Please also include the PO number in reply to this thread (procure@luminahealth.com).

I dropped the HubSpot deal link here: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/LUM-2028-0421 — I will update the close plan and mark a procurement task once Laura posts the final redline.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference


-----Original Message-----
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@luminahealth.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA scope and SCCs – clarification before legal review

Tom —

Quick update from operations: we pre-filled the TIA stub with recommended mitigations (VPC-only routing, prefix/KV caching exclusions for PHI, and optional KMS routing). See Lumina_SCCs_Impact_Summary.xlsx for the mapping. If Lumina confirms PHI datasets, we'll include the final technical evidence (SOC 2 + KMS diagram) as attachments to the DocuSign envelope.

Action items for Lumina:
- Confirm dataset sensitivity (PHI: yes/no) and preferred EU region
- Provide PO number for procurement (procure@luminahealth.com)
- Indicate whether you want the TIA pre-populated or prefer to complete after signature

Once we have the answers, Laura will finalize the redline and Ben will issue the envelope.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Privacy & Onboarding Ops, Redwood Inference


-- Attachment stubs --
1) Lumina_DPA_Redline_v1.docx (docx) — DPA with tracked changes; roles table added, TIA stub included.
2) Redwood_DPA_Template_2028-05.docx (docx) — Redwood standard processor DPA (current template).
3) Lumina_SCCs_Impact_Summary.xlsx (xlsx) — simple mapping of SCCs clauses to mitigations and evidence checklist.

-- End thread --
